single.rationale: Novanta shows steady but decelerating revenue growth (3.3% YoY) with concerning profitability deterioration—operating margin compressed from 12.5% to 9.6% and operating income fell from $110.6M to $94.0M despite revenue growth. The dramatic operating cash flow decline from $158.5M to $64.1M raises significant questions about business quality, though the improved balance sheet (net cash position after debt reduction) provides some cushion. Premium valuation (89x P/E, 99x P/FCF) appears unjustified given slowing growth and margin pressure.
